title: Genie SilentMax safety beam misaligned
shortDescription: Blue LED flashes indicate Safe-T-Beam alignment issue.
fullDescription:
Genie openers use Safe-T-Beam (STB) sensors at the bottom of the rails. A flashing blue LED on the receiver (and on the opener) signals beam interruption or misalignment.

Clean and align until both sensor LEDs are solid (red or green depending on model).

fixSteps.title: Clean lenses
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe both Safe-T-Beam lenses with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Align
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen sensor brackets, point them at each other; both LEDs must go solid.

fixSteps.title: Sun shield
fixSteps.instruction: Add a sun visor if direct sunlight hits the receiver.

faq.q: Both LEDs need to be solid?
faq.a: Yes; one solid, one off means misaligned.

title: STB sensor wire short
shortDescription: 2 LED flashes mean Safe-T-Beam sensor wire short.
fullDescription: Two flashes signal a short on the STB sensor wire. Disconnect to verify, then trace and replace damaged wire.

fixSteps.title: Replace wire
fixSteps.instruction: Run new 22-gauge bell wire from opener to STB sensors.

whenToCallPro: If wire is hidden in walls.

faq.q: Can I splice the old wire?

title: Wall console issue
shortDescription: 3 flashes indicate wall console wire short or stuck button.
fullDescription: Three flashes mean the wall console line is shorted or button stuck. Disconnect to identify; replace console if defective.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect console
fixSteps.instruction: Remove console leads; if LED clears, source is wall side.

faq.a: Most modern series-II consoles are compatible.

title: Force or limit needs adjustment
fullDescription: Four flashes indicate the opener needs limits or force reprogrammed, often after a power outage or after the trolley was manually moved.
symptoms: Door does not reach full close/open

fixSteps.title: Set travel limits
fixSteps.instruction: Press Up/Down buttons on opener per manual to set open/close positions.

faq.q: Need to reset after every outage?

title: Motor RPM or board fault
fullDescription: Five flashes mean the controller cannot sense motor rotation. Possible RPM sensor or board fault.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Order board replacement or contact Genie service.

faq.a: Yes if opener is under 10 years old.

title: Genie Aladdin Connect controller offline
shortDescription: Aladdin Connect controller cannot reach cloud.
fullDescription:
Aladdin Connect is Genie's smart garage controller (works with Genie and other openers). Offline status usually points to WiFi changes or DHCP issues.

MSI Aladdin Connect supports 2.4GHz only.

fixSteps.title: Re-add WiFi
fixSteps.instruction: Hold setup button until LED flashes; redo WiFi setup in Aladdin app.

faq.a: Yes, with most LiftMaster, Chamberlain, Craftsman openers.

title: Genie remote will not pair
shortDescription: Pairing button held but remote not learned.
fullDescription:
Genie Intellicode remotes pair using a sequence: press the round button on opener until the indicator changes, then press remote within 30 seconds.

Make sure remote is Genie Intellicode (purple Learn button) and battery is fresh.
symptoms: Remote not learned after multiple tries

fixSteps.title: Pair
fixSteps.instruction: Press round Learn on opener until LED changes; within 30s press remote button twice.

affectedModels: Genie Intellicode remotes G3T-R, GIT-1, GIT-2

title: Genie opener light flickers or burns out fast
shortDescription: Light bulbs in opener fail repeatedly.
fullDescription:
Garage door openers vibrate, breaking standard incandescent bulbs quickly. Use rough-service bulbs or LED bulbs rated for garage door use (with electromagnetic shielding).

Non-shielded LEDs interfere with the opener radio receiver, reducing remote range.
symptoms: Remote range drops to a few feet (interference)

fixSteps.title: Use rated bulb
fixSteps.instruction: Install LED bulb labeled 'garage door rated' or rough-service incandescent.

faq.q: Why does my LED kill the remote?
faq.a: Switching power supply EMI interferes with 315/390 MHz receiver.

title: Genie SilentMax belt sags or chain loose
shortDescription: Visible sag or noisy operation due to belt/chain.
fullDescription:
Over time, belts and chains stretch and require tension adjustment. Loose drives jump teeth and create noise.

Tension via the threaded shaft at the front of the rail.

fixSteps.title: Tension belt
fixSteps.instruction: Use wrench on threaded rod at rail front; tighten until belt deflects only ~1/2 inch.

whenToCallPro: If belt is damaged and needs full replacement.

faq.a: Causes premature wear and motor strain.

title: Genie Intellicode keypad does not open door
shortDescription: Outdoor wireless keypad PIN not accepted.
fullDescription:
Genie keypads use a 9V battery and pair to the opener via Intellicode. Common failures: dead battery, PIN never set, or keypad unpaired.

Reprogram by holding Program button on keypad and entering 4-9 digit PIN, then pressing opener Learn.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Program on keypad, enter PIN. Press opener Learn within 30s and re-enter PIN.
